title: Chapter 1469 - 12: Joining Forces
content:
Chapter 1469 - 12: Joining Forces

Chapter 1469: Chapter 12: Joining Forces

Lord Haotian, Fantian Lord, and other Legendary Lords, as some of the strongest lords of the current time-space.

At this moment, amidst the over five hundred terrifying figures from past and future time-spaces, they appear exceptionally inconspicuous.

Any random figure’s aura is much more frightening than theirs.

This makes Lord Haotian and the other Legendary Lords feel like they’ve returned to the weak periods of their distant past.

"No wonder, no wonder the Supreme Rule Dao’s will dares to bring down a calamity to stop the Galaxy Lord from climbing the white jade stairs."

In the hearts of Lord Haotian and the other Legendary Lords, there is both shock and realization.

It turns out the ’main force’ to stop the Galaxy Lord is not them at all.

But terrifying entities that oversee endless dimensional dimensions from different time-spaces.

Realizing this.

In the hearts of Lord Haotian and the other Legendary Lords, a thought emerges again.

Does it truly require such grand efforts to stop the Galaxy Lord from climbing the white jade stairs?

However, the Supreme Rule Dao’s will certainly cannot be wrong.

Does this mean that the true strength of the Galaxy Lord is even beyond their expectations?

...

Lord Haotian, Fantian Lord, and other Legendary Lords, observing terrifying entities from different time-spaces.

While these terrifying entities are also quietly observing their surroundings.

"Is this the time-space guided by the Supreme Rule Dao’s will?"

A colossal being, soon after opening from the endless dimensional dimension, glanced around, shocked to find that among the five hundred figures, at least twenty auras were no weaker than his own.

It’s important to know, in his own time-period, the colossal being is an absolutely invincible existence, overlooking endless dimensional dimensions.

But now?

"This time, the Supreme Rule Dao’s will has gathered so many strong beings, what exactly did that ’Galaxy’ do? Or is there an issue with his path of transcendence?"

A figure radiating infinite light scanned the surrounding strong beings with his gaze.

"I originally thought I was the only one, but I didn’t expect there to be so many? And all so strong?"

Another terrifying entity near the end of the transcendence path thought silently.

Almost all present are nearing the end of the transcendence path in the endless tribulations, well-aware of the patterns of calamities brought down by the Supreme Rule Dao’s will.

The more support given to them, the more it proves that the Galaxy Lord is not easy to handle.

"Everyone, since we’ve gathered in this time-space, presumably all agree to the calamity brought down by the Supreme Rule Dao’s will, to stop the Galaxy."

The colossal being spoke: "That Galaxy’s true body is climbing that path of transcendence, we have no other way, but under the guidance of the Supreme Rule Dao, all of Galaxy’s true bodies, avatars, and incarnations have been locked by us. Now, let’s discuss what to do?"

At the same level, if one side wants to hide, it’s quite difficult to find them.

But since the Supreme Rule Dao’s will has brought down the calamity to stop the Galaxy, it will naturally help the tribulation passers to lock the coordinates of Lin Yuan’s many true bodies, avatars, incarnations.

The Supreme Rule Dao’s will is equivalent to half a transcendence, if he makes a move to lock Lin Yuan’s coordinates, there’s no difficulty.

The colossal being spoke, and other terrifying entities from different time-spaces also began to speak and communicate.

"That Galaxy is certainly not easily dealt with."

"Of course, if he were easy to deal with, why would the Supreme Rule Dao’s will go to such lengths, gather us here? Even providing so many benefits? Even if we fail, we won’t be erased."

"Yes, the more the Supreme Rule Dao’s will acts this way, the more uncertain I feel. If I’d known so many strong beings from different time-spaces would come, I might not have come."

"Too late to regret now that we’re here, naturally we should see that Galaxy Lord."

"My thought is, do our utmost to negotiate with that Galaxy Lord, we fear him, he certainly fears us too, as long as the other side doesn’t continue to climb the path of transcendence, we can pay any price."

"Indeed, negotiate first."

"What if negotiations fail? And that Galaxy insists on climbing the path of transcendence?"

"Then there’s no choice but to kill, suppress all true bodies, avatars, incarnations of that Galaxy Lord in the outside world, to affect his mindset as much as possible when climbing the path of transcendence."

"And whether that Galaxy Lord has clansmen, relatives, offspring, or friends, they can be captured and used as threats too."

One by one, the terrifying entities spoke in turn.

Using clansmen, relatives, offspring, and friends as threats? It inevitably seems shameless, but now as long as it can influence that Galaxy, it increases the chance of passing this calamity.

And in getting past this calamity, at least a dozen terrifying entities are equivalent to directly reaching the end of the ’Infinite Tribulation’ transcendence path.

Involving the hope of true transcendence, these terrifying entities no longer care about so-called dignity, as long as they can transcend, what does shamelessness matter?

Precisely because of this, among the more than five hundred terrifying entities, even if some don’t approve of the ’threat’ method, none raised objections.

"In that case, let’s all set off together."

"That Galaxy Lord has one true body, right at this location, let’s go here first, meet him."

"Indeed, let’s all head over together."

The many terrifying entities from different time-spaces, grandly proceeded towards the direction of the Chaos Void.

With the Supreme Rule Dao’s will assisting them to lock Lin Yuan’s specific location coordinates, these terrifying entities could determine Lin Yuan’s whereabouts easily.

"What should we... do?"

Lord Haotian, Fantian Lord, and other Legendary Lords glanced at each other, being close to each other as Legendary Lords of the current time-space.
